$comment: Single source of truth for local loop configuration. Alias models are provider/model ids resolved by your GLOBAL opencode config. Variants set provider-specific reasoning effort. All scripts read this file via run/common.sh.

project.$comment: The GitHub repository is derived from this checkout's origin remote.

rules.$comment_rules: Policy executed by run/loop-tick in the fix-retry and reaper paths. Static policy, dynamic behavior.

retry_tier_up.$comment: Fires only when the implementer is tuned DOWN to code-mid (cost mode): past N failures it escalates to code-max. With the default SOTA pin (code-max) it is correctly inert.

diff_budget.$comment: Exceeded => implementer must stop and park. Tune per scope later.

github.$comment: ready-for-agent labels the frontier query. loop-integration marks a parent issue that is a real integration task; the frontier ignores labeled parents without it. Create once: gh label create ready-for-agent; gh label create loop-integration
